notes: FleetComm 1.2.1 — the stress-test batch. FLIGHT STICKS WORK NOW: no stick had ever registered a press in FleetComm (the button reader lost the values on the way through an internal boundary — the fake test stick did not), so bind them like keys: click any KEY control, press the button. The first press after plugging in is the baseline; press again to bind. HELMET CAMS lay out as a proper wall — 2x2, 3x2, 3x3 — instead of one long strip, and the scanlines stay inside the tile. OVERLAY: the armed net is now unmistakable (gold name, ARMED tag), and a held PageUp/PageDown steps exactly one net instead of skipping ahead. 1MC clips start at 35% for everyone (turn it up in the header if you want). A key bound to a net you have not tuned now tells you so instead of doing nothing. Under the hood: the audio engine is force-woken on every mic open and played frame, and the COMM LOG now prints a mic-open line with echo-cancel and engine state — if voice ever sounds laggy or doubled on first launch again, paste that line.
